entry.name: favorites
entry.label: Initial list of pinned applications (first run only).

entry.name: favoritesSeeded
entry.label: Whether the initial pinned list has already been loaded into the favorites database.

entry.name: showPinned
entry.label: Whether to show the Pinned section on the home page.

entry.name: iconSize
entry.label: Menu interface size: base icon size in pixels (32 = 100%); scales icons, fonts, tiles and the popup window.

entry.name: powerActions
entry.label: Actions shown in the power menu, in display order.

entry.name: fullscreen
entry.label: Whether the menu opens in full-screen mode (fills the work area, panels stay visible).

entry.name: popupOffsetX
entry.label: Horizontal offset of the regular menu in pixels; 0 = center of the screen.

entry.name: popupOffsetY
entry.label: Vertical offset of the regular menu in pixels; 0 = menu-to-panel gap equal to the panel's gap from the screen edge.

entry.name: popupSizeIncrease
entry.label: Size increase of the regular menu in percent; 0 = default size.

entry.name: panelHidingBackup
entry.label: Internal: remembered panel hiding modes suspended while the full-screen menu is open (screen;edge;mode).
